# Load data

load("../../data/deseq_recist_baseline.rds")
load("../../data/ra-long.rds")
load("../../data/clinical.rds")
load("../../data/microbiome_metadata.rds")
# load("../../data/counts-long.rds")
taxa <- read.csv("../../../data/2024-08-30_mpa_aggregated_long.csv")

# Figure Features 
```{r}
colors <- c("#CC6677","#999933","#6699CC","#DDCC77","#44AA99", "#882255")

# Response ID's
resp.id <- mic.meta %>%
  left_join(demographics) %>%
   mutate(Response = ifelse(Category %in% c("PR", "CR", "SD"), "Responder", 
                           ifelse(Category %in% c("PD"), "Non-Responder", 
                                  "No Response Info"))) %>%
  select(sample, Days, Response)

# make phylum level labels for every microbe
phyl_labels <- taxa %>%
  select(Taxonomy) 
# need to string split by | character 

# baseline samples 
base.samps <- mic.meta %>% 
  group_by(`Patient Id`) %>%
  arrange(Days) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

Figure 2A - Stacked Bar (RA)
```{r}
phyl.ra <- ra.l %>%
  filter(grepl("p__", microbe))

top.phyl <- phyl.ra %>%
  group_by(microbe) %>%
  summarise(med.abun = median(RelAbun)) %>%
  arrange(desc(med.abun)) %>%
  filter(med.abun > 0)

phyl.ra <- phyl.ra %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(microbe %in% top.phyl$microbe, gsub("p__", "", microbe), 
                         "Other")) %>%
  left_join(resp.id)

phyl.ra %>%
  filter(RelAbun > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = RelAbun)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(microbe)) +
  geom_histogram() 

# all samples 
phyl.ra %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = RelAbun, fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) + 
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank()) +
  facet_grid(~Response, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 6, nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

ggsave("../../figures/fig2a-stackedbar.png", height = 4, width = 6)

#baseline samples only
phyl.ra %>%
  filter(sample %in% base.samps$sample) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = RelAbun, fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) + 
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank()) +
  facet_grid(~Response, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 6, nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))
ggsave("../../figures/fig2a-stackedbar-baseline.png", height = 4, width = 6)
```
